fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local political commentary on the Miami Crime Commission and federal investigations, and a detailed account criticizing the handling and reporting of the Miami Herald warehouse fire. It reports on alleged press-bribery and corruption involving medical associations and opposition to a national health program, and covers church opposition to gambling and racetracks. Additional items address voter registration and municipal politics in Miami (including discussion of an anti-Communist oath requirement), municipal court cases, tourism and Florida economic matters, and local transportation and civic affairs.
